title: I found an AI that literally vibes with my mood.
author: realtechwarrior
selftext:
Last night I tried this new app called YappRoom, it’s like therapy + roleplay + crypto mining all in one.

You talk, it listens like a bestie, and every convo earns you coins (they call it FAYR Coins).

Feels like Gen-Z finally got its own AI RPG.

Would you actually use an app like this instead of a group chat/diary?

comments.author: BlobbyMcBlobber
comments.body: I honestly don't understand people using AI as a friend. You're talking to software. If this is what you do for emotional support, maybe consider meeting new people or getting therapy (not a diss, just maybe connect with real people).

replies.author: realtechwarrior
replies.body: You are right, I see it as a self talk where you can get replies that seem meaningful in a judgement free way. It is not a substitute for a human bond.

replies.author: realtechwarrior
replies.body: Yes you are partially right, I tagged it as such. It is completely free. It does not even offer any purchases. I just need some feedback on what you are thinking about it. Thank you.

replies.author: itsCheshire
replies.body:
Partially right my ass. Your post history shows that you didn't "try this new app" last night, you're the *creator* of this app. And so the issue is that this post is a blatant lie in how it's framed, so why would anyone trust the product behind it?

And that's before we acknowledge that it's literally a fusion between an AI companion and a literal crypto currency xD

replies.author: realtechwarrior
replies.body:
You are right, I did it for engagement. Yes it is a fusion. Do you like the idea? Would you be willing to try it out? 

I am sorry.

replies.author: _raydeStar
replies.body:
You labeled it right.  I did not see that.  My apologies.  

I am not fond of someone pretending to be a customer but they are actually trying to sell something.  Perhaps I am wrong.  

My suggestion is to make a 30 second demo - very short - then give the user some \*free value\* inside of the message, with more free value on your site. Once they are there, they can sign up for your newsletter, check out the product, etc.

replies.author: realtechwarrior
replies.body: Appreciate the words, thanks. Will improve.

replies.author: digitaldisgust
replies.body: LOL this dev is a hot mess. Seems like they love to lie and mislead on here.

comments.author: Willing-Emergency237
comments.body: Can I turn Fayr coins into money?

replies.author: realtechwarrior
replies.body: That's the core idea. There are many ways to do that, which way is still to be realised.
